title: Cache-Bounded State Management for Recursive LLM Agent Swarms using Deterministic Addressing and Hierarchical Summarization: code and results
description:
Reference implementation of the Bounded Infinity Cache (BIC), a fixed-capacity cache for the working state of recursive multi-agent LLM systems, together with the baselines, experiment drivers, per-run result logs and the scripts that produce every table and figure of the accompanying manuscript.

The experiments/results/round2 directory holds the GPT-5.4 runs (per-agent original and reconstructed texts included); experiments/results/synthetic_fixed holds the synthetic experiments. Records that predate the correction of an evaluation error are kept in experiments/results/round2/superseded_stale_flag with an explanatory README.
